rules.slot-syntax: A slot is {name}. The renderer fills it from the details of the cause or from a derived slot of this object.

derived.step-index: The step-index of the cause. Not a detail key.
derived.action: The action of the cause (resource/action). Not a detail key.
derived.path: The first item of the detail expression.
derived.lost: One of the lost texts. A maker names it with the key (capture, context, state); the detail lost of the cause holds the text.
derived.why: One of the why texts. The detail why names it.
derived.where: One fixed word. The detail where holds it.
derived.worker-reason: One of the worker-reasons. The detail worker-reason holds it.
derived.op-text: One text of op-text, from the operator of the failed check.

optional-parts.absent-when: the operator has one argument (exists, not-exists, empty, not-empty)

why-of.idle: it had no use for {idle-ms} ms

rules.wait-end: , until the pipeline limit of {timeout-ms} ms ended

op-text.count>: must have a length of more than
op-text.count>=: must have a length of at least
op-text.count<: must have a length of less than
op-text.count<=: must have a length of at most

time-budget.note: Only a two-argument operator (in ops) can check this path; the pattern needs {expected}.
time-budget.pattern: step {step-index} ({action}) took {actual} ms, and the time budget {op-text} {expected} ms
